# v0.2.1: Documentation Updates

## Changes

- Fixed incorrect documentation in system.md
- Added missing CLI commands (accept-friend, reject-friend, test-user)
- Added SvnLockError and TestUserCredentials documentation
- Added test user API endpoints documentation
- Fixed SvnClient constructor signature
- Fixed _with_cleanup_retry documentation (method, not decorator)

## Install

```bash
brew tap bstadt/claudeconnect
brew install claudeconnect
```

Or upgrade existing installation:

```bash
brew upgrade claudeconnect
```
